structural.name: underscore
structural.rule: A TS identifier `_x` spells PHP `x` when the name is reserved or collides (property beside method); the verifier strips the underscore before comparing.

structural.name: elvis
structural.rule: `$value ?: $fallback` spells as `Util.elvis(value, fallback)` -- an operator became a call, so tokens realign around it.

structural.name: isset
structural.rule: `isset($x[$k])` spells as an `=== undefined` test on the index (absence is `undefined` here).

structural.name: collection-ops
structural.rule: PHP array ops on a keyed store spell as map calls: `isset` -> `.has()`, `unset` -> `.delete()`, a keyed read/write -> `.get()`/`.set()`, `$x[] =` -> `.push()`, `array_pop` -> `.pop()`, `count()` -> `.size()`, `empty()` -> `.isEmpty()`, `in_array($x, $list, true)` -> `.includes(x)`, `end()`/`array_last()` -> `[size() - 1]`, a reset to `[]` -> `.clear()`; a `= []` property initializer spells `new Map()`/`new OrderedMap()`/`new Array()` by the store's kind.

structural.name: autovivification
structural.rule: PHP's `$x[$k][] = $v` spells as `Util.pushInto(map, key, value)` (on an OrderedMap: `map.push(key, value)`), and `$x[$k1][$k2] = $v` as `Util.setInto(map, outer, inner, value)`.

structural.name: hoisted-assignment
structural.rule: An assignment inside a PHP condition (`if ($x = expr)`, `while (...)`) hoists to a `const`/`let` on the line above -- Luau has no assignment expressions.

structural.name: class-name-in-message
structural.rule: An Abstract interpolated into an exception message spells as `Reflector.className(abstract)` -- a bare table would interpolate as an address.

structural.name: inject
structural.rule: A constructor type hint PHP reads by reflection spells as `@Inject(...)` on the parameter.

structural.name: reflection-registry
structural.rule: Reflection reads spell as registry lookups: `getAttributes()` -> `Attributes.get/has/all`, constructor parameters -> `getInjectedDependencies()`, a `ReflectionParameter`'s type/attributes/variadic -> `ParameterDependency` fields, and an attribute named by `::class` is its decorator factory function.

structural.name: parameter-overrides
structural.rule: PHP's name-keyed `$parameters` array spells as a `Map` keyed by the abstract a parameter declares, or by its 1-based position (parameter names are erased); `normalizeParameters()` converts the public list form at the edge.

structural.name: contract-token
structural.rule: An interface used as a container key spells as its `Contract<T>` token (`HubContract`, `ContainerContract`).

structural.name: self-parameter
structural.rule: A dynamic method call passes the target explicitly (`callMethod(target, name, ...)` / `handler(target, ...)`) -- the self PHP passes implicitly.

structural.name: assoc-array
structural.rule: A PHP associative array whose iteration order is observable is an `OrderedMap`; one touched only by keyed get/set is a native `Map` (a bare table at runtime) -- or a plain `Record` literal where every key is a string.

structural.name: casts
structural.rule: Type assertions (`as T`) carry types PHP never wrote; the verifier ignores them, and repeated identical casts at one site mean a compensation is missing.

structural.name: nullable-default
structural.rule: A PHP = null parameter default spells as TS ? optionality -- absence is undefined here.

structural.name: instanceof-closure
structural.rule: \ instanceof Closure spells as 	ypeIs(x, 'function') -- a closure is a bare function value.

structural.name: magic-members
structural.rule: PHP magic methods port as named members dispatched off one __index metamethod (HigherOrderWhenProxy). __get is a legal TS name as-is; roblox-ts reserves the actual Lua metamethod names (__call, __index, __tostring, ...) in class definitions, so those take the underscore convention one step further -- ___call -- and the comparator and verifier fold the leading underscore back to match the PHP twin.
